sentences.en: I usually wake up at six.
I make my bed every morning.
Then I drink a glass of water.
I try not to check my phone immediately.
Breakfast helps me start the day.
I leave home at half past seven.
My commute takes about twenty minutes.
sentences.ar: يستغرق طريقي إلى العمل نحو عشرين دقيقة.

sentences.en: I listen to English on the way.
I write down my main tasks.
I take short breaks while working.
I always keep a bottle of water nearby.
sentences.ar: أحتفظ دائمًا بزجاجة ماء بالقرب مني.

sentences.en: I eat lunch at the same time most days.
sentences.ar: أتناول الغداء في الوقت نفسه معظم الأيام.

sentences.en: Sometimes my schedule changes.
I try to stay flexible.
I go for a walk after work.
Walking helps me clear my mind.
I cook dinner at home.
I prefer simple, healthy meals.
I clean the kitchen before relaxing.
I call my family in the evening.
I read a few pages before bed.
I set an alarm for tomorrow.
I try to sleep early.
I do not always follow my routine.
It is okay to start again.
sentences.ar: لا بأس أن أبدأ من جديد.

sentences.en: Small habits make a big difference.
I am trying to spend less time online.
sentences.ar: أحاول تقليل الوقت الذي أقضيه على الإنترنت.

sentences.en: I want to exercise more regularly.
I keep track of my progress.
Consistency matters more than perfection.
I feel better when I plan ahead.
My weekends are more relaxed.
sentences.ar: عطلات نهاية الأسبوع عندي أكثر هدوءًا.

sentences.en: A good routine saves time.
Tomorrow is another chance to improve.
